      protected abstract T convertLogicalType(TypeDescriptor<?> type)
      Handles JSR-310 (LocalDate, LocalTime, LocalDateTime, Instant) and UUID fields, which StaticSchemaInference infers as Beam Schema.LogicalTypes. Subclasses emit code that round-trips through the corresponding static Schema.LogicalType instance (ByteBuddyUtils.JAVA_LOCAL_DATE_LOGICAL_TYPE etc.).
